Meta Test Description: This testcase (mipi_csi2_rb_reg_wr_rd_test) performs register read/write verification for the MIPI CSI2 RB register block (csi_reg block). The test consists of two main phases: (1) chk_rst_val — reads each register and compares the read value against the expected default/reset value from default_value_array, skipping non-readable registers (read_mask_array == 0x00000000), incrementing def_fail_cnt on mismatch; (2) chk_rd_wr — writes data_wr to each writable register (skipping entries in skip_array and non-writable registers), then reads back and compares against an expected value computed as exp_val = ((data_wr & read_mask_array[i] & write_mask_array[i]) | (wr_n & read_mask_array[i] & default_value_array[i])), where wr_n is the inverted write mask, incrementing wr_fail_cnt on mismatch. Registers flagged in skip_array (INTERRUPT_RAW at index 5, FLUSH at index 9) are skipped during chk_rd_wr. A soft_reset_chk function is defined but its call is commented out in test_case. The test concludes with finish(1) if any failures occurred (def_fail_cnt > 0 || wr_fail_cnt > 0), or finish(0) otherwise. 10 registers are addressed from the csi_reg block: virtual_channel, line_info, fifo_threshold_val, lane_clk, mem, interrupt_raw, interrupt_mask, interrupt_enable, control_data, flush.
